description: This Java class file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface. The class acts as a filter for logging, passing only message content to the next LogNode in the chain, omitting metadata like priority, tag, and throwable objects.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter that only forwards message content, ignoring other metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Processes log entries and forwards only the message to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
